title: Pillowy Dutch Pancakes with Fresh Tomato
description: A simple breakfast recipe featuring the fluffiest dutch pancakes topped with fresh tomato and a side of skillet-cooked bacon.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, whisk together flour, milk, eggs, and melted butter.
2. Stir in sugar and let the mixture rest for 10 minutes.
3. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat.
4. Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop batter onto skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes.
5. Flip pancakes and cook for another 1-2 minutes.
6. Meanwhile, cook bacon in a separate skillet until crispy.
7. Serve pancakes hot with fresh tomato slices and skillet-cooked bacon.
